answer.answer: Out of 115 amine-functionalised PS zeta-potential values reported, 66 (about 57%) are negative, mostly measured in culture media, salt solutions, or environmental water where corona formation or ionic screening reverses the charge. So these particles are not consistently positively charged; they tend to be positive mainly in DI water and often turn negative in biological/saline media.
